title: Application to Visa Process Steps for France (EEF 2026–27)
notice: Applications for France now go through the Etudes en France (EEF) portal. For universities not listed on EEF, direct application through the individual university portal is required.

processSteps.label: University Application : Etudes en France (EEF) Portal
bullets: Apply via EEF — covers most public universities in France
Apply via University Portal if not listed on EEF

processSteps.label: EEF Application Fee : BDT 12,170
bullets: Campus France will review preliminary application documents and provide instructions for payment

processSteps.label: Pre-Consular Interview : Campus France Dhaka
bullets: Mandatory for EEF applicants: interview at Alliance Française Dhaka

processSteps.label: Offer Letter
bullets: Tuition Fees: 254–6,000 euro (varies by program and university)
Initial deposit for seat confirmation may be required

processSteps.label: Direct Admission : Universities Not on EEF
bullets: Students who directly applied in university portals and got offer
You need to open account in EEF, upload documents, pay EEF fee & attend pre-consular interview upon Campus france instruction
Students applied through EEF, did not got offer, but later got an offer through direct application can upload their documents also.

processSteps.label: Student & Campus Contribution Fee (CVEC) : 105 euro/year
bullets: Mandatory for all students — pay at messervices.etudiant.gouv.fr

processSteps.label: Accommodation Booking : 1,000 – 2,000 euros
bullets: University residence (CROUS) or private — booking confirmation needed for visa

costSteps.label: France-Visas Application
bullets: Fill up visa application form at france-visas.gouv.fr
Wait for Campus France instruction to submit your documents at VFS

costSteps.label: Show Fund : (878 euros/month × Years of Study) + Rest Tuition Fees
bullets: Sponsors Source of Funds: Bank Statement, Salary Certificate, Income Tax Return, Business Trade License, etc.

costSteps.label: Visa Fee (D) : 99 euro | VFS Fee : 22 euro
bullets: Submit at VFS Global Dhaka — Rangs Z Square, Level 7, Gulshan 2
